svg.desc: Draft coordinates: pH visually estimated from si_pH.png; nominal 2.0 V RHE at both endpoints for every electrode, including Cu. Dashed boxes show the reference envelope, pH 10.5-13.5 and -2 to +2 V RHE. Endpoints are shown without connecting lines.
